notes.title: 🌸 Yuri Visual Novel "Clover Reset" Release Date Announced! 🍀
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248290/3ea85b9030bc724e80bbbc40723eee462b64614f.jpg[/img]

[u][b]🗓️ Clover Reset, a yuri visual novel about youth and connection, is coming to Steam on May 30th![/b][/u]

A bittersweet yet heartwarming story of girls who, despite their differences, come to admire and care for each other.
With each step they take, they grow closer, finding courage and discovering themselves along the way.
If you enjoy tales of love, friendship, and admiration, this heartfelt visual novel is for you.

Whether you've been waiting for this moment or are just hearing about it now, we hope you'll give it a try!

🌟 Check out the store page here! 👇
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/Clover_Reset/

notes.title: The yuri coming-of-age visual novel "Clover Reset" demo is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/5d519c91a659bd461dd473d2af0a4d4687f35b2f.jpg[/img]

A story where love blossoms from the moment they meet— 🍀 "Clover Reset" 🍀 demo is now live!

Character design and illustrations are brought to life by the renowned Japanese artist "Kukiha", known for their beautiful portrayals of youthful heroines. The game also features an incredible voice cast, including Saho Shirasuna, Yūki Takada, Yūki Kuwahara, and Noriko Shibasaki, creating an immersive and heartwarming school romance drama.
—————————————————————
"Do you know the meaning of the four-leaf clover?"
"Besides 'happiness,' there's another..."

Set in "Shonan Talent Academy", located in the scenic Shonan area of Kanagawa,
this is a story of girls and their love, beginning with a single four-leaf clover—
—————————————————————

If this sounds like your kind of story, give it a try!
Don't forget to wishlist us on STEAM and stay tuned for updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/Clover_Reset/

notes.title: Yuri Romance Visual Novel Game "The Vampire's Bride: The Novel Game" First PV Officially Released!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/da6fdedfd0cb8945e65b80f74218c30c65a1cfc2.jpg[/img]

Developed by Waterfall, a circle founded by the renowned Japanese manga artist Saku Takano, and published internationally by miraiworks, the fully-voiced yuri visual novel "The Vampire’s Bride: The Novel Game" has officially revealed its first PV!
With the theme of "Vampire × Military Uniforms × Yuri," this game tells a pure love story of girls bound by blood!
 The game is set to release in 2025 and will be available on Windows and Mac!
 Interested players, don’t forget to add it to your wishlist~~!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3109650/The_Vampires_Bride_The_Novel_Game/
Story Synopsis

This is the first love between a non-human girl and a human girl.
One day, a girl is led to a mysterious military facility deep within the forest.
 There, she meets a vampire—
 A beautiful girl known as a "Vampdoll."
The girl Sanagi is offered as a sacrifice to the Vampdoll.
Amidst this cruel fate, the two gradually fall for each other.
——However,
The battles against man-eating monsters begin to tear them apart——
Stay tuned for more updates if you're interested!

notes.title: Yuri Visual Novel "Clover Reset" Crowdfunding Reaches 1.5 Million Yen! Adding English ver. is officially confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/01b99dadffdfbc5d25b99b3dba7d3dd92059c300.jpg[/img]

The yuri visual novel Clover Reset, a game you'll fall in love with the moment you see it, has recently reached 1.5 million yen in its crowdfunding campaign, successfully meeting all of our goals, including the stretch goals!

We've received support from many fans, including a significant number from English-speaking regions. To make sure even more yuri fans around the world can enjoy the game, we've decided to create an English version!

While there's still some time before the release, we truly appreciate your patience and hope you're looking forward to it!

Although we've reached our crowdfunding goal, the campaign is still ongoing! If you'd like to, we'd be grateful for your continued support!

For more details, please visit the project page:
[url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/785134/] CampFire Clover Reset Project Page[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/Clover_Reset/

notes.title: 新感覚青春百合ノベルゲーム『Clover Reset』、制作支援クラウドファンディングスタート！
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/153cc2b995357c93c91352b03379f90701f7178a.jpg[/img]

青春系女の子のイラストを得意とする人気イラストレーター【くきは】氏がキャラクターデザイン・原画を手掛け、実力派声優の『白砂沙帆』さん、『高田憂希』さん、『桑原由気』さん、『芝崎典子』さんらが魅力的なキャラクターたちに命を吹き込む百合恋愛アドベンチャーゲーム『Clover Reset』。本作の制作支援プロジェクトが、日本のクラウドファンディングサイト「CampFire」にて開始されました！

詳しくはプロジェクトページをご覧ください：
[url=https://camp-fire.jp/projects/785134/]CampFire「Clover Reset」プロジェクトページ[/url]

『Clover Reset』は、「違いがあるからこそ憧れ、好きになる……」をテーマに、それぞれ異なる世界観や個性を持つ少女たちが紡ぎ出す青春ドラマを描きます。甘さや感動、そしてほんの少しの驚きも味わえる、心温まる百合ノベルゲームです。
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/4f059f3ed9eac5f12a7e7257e644acdd623b1330.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/4ba013b346bf5b8358730bba9fa68673f72f96df.jpg[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/36792781/b5ee12f0f8b74108de8231930adb22b026b3e86b.jpg[/img]

本プロジェクトにご興味をお持ちの方は、ぜひ制作支援のご検討をお願いいたします。あなたの応援が、この素晴らしい作品の完成に繋がります！

皆さまのご支援を心よりお待ちしております！

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239250/
